title: Why Would I Deceive You? The Apartment Tour

youtube_title: Why Would I Deceive You? The Apartment Tour | Funny Cartoon
description:
A smooth-talking realtor shows Dana and her brother Kofi a tiny apartment where the hallway is the kitchen and the thermostat is a sticker.
The scratching in the wall has a lease, a top hat and opinions about cheese.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #apartment
tiktok_caption: the heat works. why would he deceive you? #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #apartment

lines.text: Welcome to your new home. Spacious, sunny, and the heat works.
Why would I deceive you?
I have not even taken my coat off and I already have questions.
I have zero questions. I love it. Is there a dishwasher?
There is a dishwasher.
Where?
You are looking at him.
I respect that.
Okay. The listing said six hundred square feet.
And it delivers. Every one of them is right here.
This is the hallway.
The hallway is also the kitchen. Open concept.
I love a concept.
And the bathroom is right next to the stove.
You can shower and make toast at the same time.
Why would anyone want that?
Busy mornings. Why would I deceive you?
I am going to be so efficient.
Next. The listing said natural light.
Look at that window.
It faces a brick wall.
That brick gets sun at four fifteen. For nine minutes.
And then it bounces in here. Golden hour.
Nine minutes of gold. Dana, that is so much gold.
Kofi, you could see that wall with a flashlight.
Then we will bring a flashlight. Problem solved.
Fine. It is November. Tell me the heat works.
The heat works.
Why would I deceive you?
Wait. What is that noise?
That is the radiator saying hello.
It has been saying hello for two minutes.
It is very friendly. It has been saying hello since nineteen ninety.
And the thermostat?
Right there on the wall. Set to seventy two.
Vince. That is a sticker.
It is a very confident sticker.
It does make me feel warmer.
You are wearing two hats.
Last thing. Are the neighbors quiet?
Extremely quiet. You will never even see them.
What is that scratching in the wall?
That is the quiet.
Evening.
There is a mouse.
There is a landlord. Please wipe your feet.
Vince. The mouse is the landlord?
Technically, yes. I rent from him.
He lives in the closet. He pays on time. Mostly in crackers.
The closet is very spacious. I have a lamp.
So you have been lying this entire tour.
Why would I deceive you?
He deceives everyone. It is his only hobby.
But the heat does work. I know, because I am the heat.
The mouse is the heat?
I run in a little wheel behind the radiator. That is the hello.
Okay. How much is the rent?
Eight hundred dollars a month. And cheese on Sundays.
Eight hundred dollars. In this city.
With golden hour.
We will take it.
Welcome home. Spacious, sunny, and the heat works.
The cheese is not optional.
Vince, can I see the closet?
It has a lamp. Why would I deceive you?
He does not have a lamp.
